subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about rockslide is correct?

options.text: It affects only the outermost layer of the rock face
It is slower than rock fall
It involves backward rotation of debris
It affects material to considerable depth

solution:
The correct answer is __**It affects material to considerable depth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Rockslides are a form of mass wasting, characterized by the downslope movement of rock material along a bedding plane, fracture, or other structural weakness.
 
• Unlike rockfalls, rockslides involve the sliding of large masses of rock, which often penetrates to significant depths within the geological formation.
 
• T
